**QA Result: Member Lookup for "EXPIRED"**

After navigating to Member Lookup (MBR-10) and entering **EXPIRED** in the Member Number field, then clicking **F6 - Locate**, the system returns the following result (reproducible):

**Page Title:** Session Expired COREBANK / TELLER 7.4

**Visible Result:**
> SESSION E01The CoreBank session is no longer valid. Sign-in by a human operator is required.

**Code:** `E01`

**Required Next Step:**  
> The operation has stopped. Do not retry automatically.

A link **"Return to member lookup"** is presented, which does return to the MBR-10 search screen when clicked, indicating this is the specific system response to the member number **EXPIRED** rather than an actual session timeout.

**Evidence:** Screenshot saved as `member-expired-result.png`.
